When the technology on your regular route stops making sense
caption:
The future doesn't send an invitation. It just shows up on a regular morning commute, looking completely out of place and completely real at the same time.

This clip is exactly that moment. No rehearsal, no studio. Just what the road outside looks like when the line between science fiction and a Tuesday morning gets thin enough to cross.

The people who notice it first tend to be the ones already paying attention.
